node.label: mucolipidosis
node.definition: A group of inherited lysosomal storage diseases characterized by accumulation of lipids and carbohydrates in the tissues, resulting in mental disabilities and skeletal malformations.

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
